title: What is Everyone Pay?
summary: This document defines “Everyone Pay” as Rho-Bank’s payment capability for sending funds to individuals or businesses from your account. It states new-account limits of $750/day and $7,500/month (both apply simultaneously), and explains how your available amount updates after each completed send and how resuming works after reaching caps.
